title: `concepts/islamic-sufi-philosophy-of-consciousness` L49 quotes al-Ghazālī as saying mind and matter are "so utterly different in their essences that one cannot affect the other", which is Wikipedia's "Occasionalism" gloss of the Cartesian motive, not his; L85 also pairs fanā' with *nirodha-samāpatti* as "heightened awareness", against the Map's own cessation pages
